task.title: Claim the next available recurrence occurrence
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/951 to atomically reserve the earliest due available coordinate in one bounded authored window.
acceptance_criteria: Select sparse persisted or released coordinates deterministically through an inclusive cutoff.
Preserve cursor progress for future, all-gap, and finite windows with typed failures.
Guarantee earliest-selection semantics under concurrency and selected-window corruption isolation.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found a major race because only the chosen stream was guarded; commit cbedf6a atomically guarded the recurrence and every selected-window stream and restarted selection after any version change.
attempts.patch: Applied blocking findings where present, reran verification, required substantive review, and preserved zero unresolved review threads before merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 951 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 952 exact head

lessons: Earliest-available correctness requires guarding the complete selection snapshot.
Absent streams are part of the observed snapshot and need version guards.
The operation grants no global discovery, ambient clock, worker, permission, or execution authority.
